keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no row). The page gives no area: 'The area of Saxe-Merseburg stretched to the western city limits of Leipzig' and it held 'the estates of the former Bishopric of Merseburg' and 'the Margraviate of Lower Lusatia, including the cities and castles of Lübben'. Circles: Merseburg 11.99E 51.36N 28 km; Lübben 13.90E 51.94N 22 km; soft. Revised after review: the first shape was a 28 km circle at Merseburg and a 22 km circle at Lübben (about 4,300 km2), which left out Doberlug, Finsterwalde, Forst and Guben and the Delitzsch-Bitterfeld lands that the page names. The shape is now the union electorate-of-saxony uses for its 1657 loss (Merseburg and Lützen 18 km, Delitzsch and Bitterfeld 18 km, Lower Lusatia west 28 km, east 28 km); the gazetteer has no 'Lower Lusatia' region yet, to be swapped in when it has. The page gives no area (only that the duchy stretched 'to the western city limits of Leipzig'), so no infobox ratio is possible; Saxony's ledger gives 7,081 km2 for the loss and the circles resolve to a smaller figure on the grid.

ledger.note: 22 April 1657: the treaty. 'After the elector died on 8 October 1656, his sons concluded the "friend-brotherly main treaty" in the Saxon residence of Dresden on 22 April 1657'; 'a further treaty in 1663 delineating their territories and sovereign rights definitively'; infobox 'Split off from Saxony: 1657'; the lead: 'from 1656 or 1657 to 1738'. Revised after review: region is now the whole Merseburg-Delitzsch-Bitterfeld land and the Margraviate of Lower Lusatia, the same union as electorate-of-saxony's 1657 loss and 1738 gain.

notes:
Written 2026-10-25 for batch eu-09-x (1 page; budget 1-2). New state: Cliopatria has no Saxe-Merseburg row.

SCOPE. An Albertine secundogeniture, 1657 to 1738. The estates of the former Bishopric of Merseburg ('secularised in 1565' in one sentence, 1562 in another) and Lower Lusatia are named without years of acquisition, so the first keyframe holds both. The page is silent on wars. The infobox's predecessor and successor fields are garbled on the page.

SHAPES. Merseburg 11.99E 51.36N 28 km; Lubben 13.90E 51.94N 22 km. Gazetteer names wanted: 'Merseburg', 'Lübben'.

NOT SETTLED. (1) No area; (2) 1562 against 1565 for the secularisation of the bishopric; (3) the Spremberg and Bad Lauchstadt appanages are named without dates.

COUNTERPARTS NEEDING DOSSIERS: none new.

REVISION 2026-10-25 (after review). The shape was Merseburg 28 km plus Lübben 22 km; the page (reopened) names Merseburg, Plagwitz, Rückmarsdorf, Delitzsch, Bad Lauchstädt, Schkeuditz, Lützen, Bitterfeld, Zörbig and the Margraviate of Lower Lusatia with Lübben, Doberlug, Finsterwalde, Döbern, Forst and Guben. It is now the four-circle union electorate-of-saxony uses for its 1657 loss and 1738 gain (K0, found, dissolve, predecessor and successor lands). The page gives no area, so the area check cannot be computed. MIRROR: electorate-of-saxony names the counterpart 'saxe-merseburg' (L24 1657, L29 1738); this dossier's slug is duchy-of-saxe-merseburg, so the mirror does not match by slug (same for saxe-weissenfels and saxe-zeitz); Saxony's dossier was not touched in this repair. Gazetteer names wanted: 'Lower Lusatia' (region), 'Merseburg', 'Delitzsch', 'Bitterfeld', 'Guben', 'Forst (Lausitz)'.
